headline: Colombia Proposes 'Rescue Law' Overhauling Income Tax and Corporate Burdens
summary: The Colombian government introduced a fiscal 'Rescue Law' project featuring 16-year tax benefits for megaprojects, adjusted income tax brackets introducing a 9% initial taxable tier from 2027, and variable payroll costs.
why: Comprehensive tax reform proposals alter corporate tax liabilities, investment incentives, and disposable income structures, directly impacting corporate earnings projections and domestic capital expenditures.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Tax structural changes alter corporate profitability and consumer disposable income across the economy.
